pages.text: $(item)Harmonic of Resonance$()$(br2)A frequency drawn from the deepest, oldest stone. It hums with the memory of breaking.
$(bold)Attunement$()$(br)Strike an Unattuned Fork against bedrock at the very bottom of the world This will tune it to become the Harmonic of Resonance.

$(bold)Use$()$(br)Functions as both a mining tool and a weapon. As you continue to mine blocks with it, you hone its power to make it grow stronger.  Each tier will increase both its mining level and its strength in combat.$(br2)A newly attuned Harmonic starts modest. Given time and use, it becomes something far more capable, something that can destroy even the toughest of materials.
